title: Rent control debate intensifies as IFS warns of supply risks
summary:
Housing Secretary Angela Rayner faces pressure from 26 MPs to introduce rent controls, despite IFS warnings that such measures could reduce housing supply and push down property prices. The government has confirmed it has no plans to implement rent controls.

The post Rent control debate intensifies as IFS warns of supply risks appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Pet ownership drives homebuying decisions, new data shows
summary:
One in ten prospective homebuyers in the UK is seeking to purchase property specifically to own a pet, according to new research from Skipton Building Society. The lender's data reveals that an additional 11% of buyers are actively searching for pet-friendly properties.

The post Pet ownership drives homebuying decisions, new data shows appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Limited company structures now account for 45% of BTL ownership
summary:
Limited company ownership now accounts for 45.1% of buy-to-let properties in the UK, with the structure becoming the dominant model among landlords with larger portfolios. Analysis shows that for landlords with 20 or more properties, 57.6% now operate through limited company structures.

The post Limited company structures now account for 45% of BTL ownership appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Lettings agent falsely claimed industry membership
summary:
A Birmingham-based lettings agent accused of withholding tenant deposits and failing to pass rent to landlords has been found falsely presenting himself as a member of Propertymark, the industry trade body.

The post Lettings agent falsely claimed industry membership appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: UK home searches rise 7% despite 9% drop in buyer purchasing power
summary:
Home searches across the UK have increased by 7% year-on-year following a quiet summer period, according to new data from Zoopla. However, buyers are facing a 9% reduction in purchasing power due to rising mortgage costs, with average five-year fixed rates climbing from below 4% in January to approximately 4.8% currently.

The post UK home searches rise 7% despite 9% drop in buyer purchasing power appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Letting agent use reaches two-year high in England and Wales
summary:
Two thirds of rental properties in England and Wales are now managed by letting agents, marking the highest proportion in two years. The National Residential Landlords Association attributes the rise to increasing regulatory complexity and calls for accelerated training standards.

The post Letting agent use reaches two-year high in England and Wales appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Pivot provides £1.3m facility for Yeadon housing scheme
summary:
Pivot Finance has provided a £1.3 million phased development facility for a residential scheme in Yeadon, approximately eight miles north west of Leeds city centre. The 21-month facility will fund the refurbishment of an existing detached house and the construction of four new family homes.

The post Pivot provides £1.3m facility for Yeadon housing scheme appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Land Registry adds property identifiers to price data
summary:
HM Land Registry has begun publishing Unique Property Reference Numbers and INSPIRE IDs alongside its monthly Price Paid Data. The identifiers aim to improve property matching accuracy for estate agents, portals and lenders across England and Wales.

The post Land Registry adds property identifiers to price data appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Spectrum Building leaseholders face mortgage payments two years after fire
summary:
Leaseholders of flats destroyed in the Spectrum Building fire in Dagenham continue to pay mortgages on properties that no longer exist, two years after the blaze. The bankruptcy of freeholder Arinium Ltd has left more than 80 residents in legal limbo, uncertain about compensation timing or amounts.

The post Spectrum Building leaseholders face mortgage payments two years after fire appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Sourced Group acquires Open House estate agents
summary:
Sourced Group has acquired Open House Estate Agents, bringing 104 franchisees into its network and offering them access to a funded acquisitions programme. The combined network now comprises more than 230 franchisees across the UK.
